hook: Telangana asks banks for a *12-month* pause on drought-hit crop loans
hook_b: Telangana asks banks for a *12-month* pause on drought-hit crop loans
tldr: The state has asked banks to give a 12-month moratorium and stretch repayment to 60 months for borrowers in 111 severely drought-hit mandals.

beats.what: For 254 moderately affected mandals, it seeks a 12-month moratorium and a 36-month repayment extension.
beats.why: Telangana declared 365 mandals drought-affected, 111 of them severely.
beats.care: Farm families in these mandals could get breathing room on loans; borrowers can opt out within 135 days of the Oct 24 declaration.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The SLBC, chaired by Deputy CM Mallu Bhatti Vikramarka, also resolved to give extra need-based loans to eligible farmers.

cards.q: Is a loan pause the right kind of drought relief?

qs: How many farmers in the 111 mandals carry crop loans?
Will banks act before the 135-day window ends?

facts.t: Borrowers can opt out of the plan till *135 days* from the Oct 24 calamity declaration.

viz.verdict: 365 mandals hit; relief depends on severity

learn.t: SLBC = State Level Bankers Committee, which coordinates banks in a state

watch: SLBC wants the Centre to extend interest subvention on rescheduled crop loans till repayment ends.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Telangana govt seeks 12-month gap in crop loan repayment for farmers in drought-hit mandals

fact: Telangana wants banks to pause crop loans for *12 months* in drought mandals
twist: Banks are asked to find eligible accounts themselves, without waiting for farmers to apply.
